[[Bastila Shan]] owned a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|single-blade]] '''lightsaber''' during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. She used this lightsaber when she lead a [[Jedi strike team (Capture of Darth Revan)|Jedi strike team]] to [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
